name: cmrm
description: CLI tool to manage and switch Claude and Codex CLI configurations

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=es2017 --outfile=dist/cli.js --minify --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && chmod +x dist/cli.js && mkdir -p dist/locales && cp -r src/i18n/locales/*.json dist/locales/
scripts.build:dev: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=es2017 --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && chmod +x dist/cli.js && mkdir -p dist/locales && cp -r src/i18n/locales/*.json dist/locales/

author: lvdaxianer
